review_scope: H388 full-data H384 teacher trio, selective FP16 transport, Q8VNNI callback, exposed diagnostic grade, and Python 3.11 exact-ZIP panel

runtime.precision_assertion: native EnsemblePredictor reports q8vnni for the 3-member ensemble
runtime.weights_transport: The four GRU recurrent matrices and head.0.weight are stored as float16; all other tensors remain float32. Existing runtime expands arrays for the Q8VNNI native callback. This is storage compression, not FP16 inference.

exposed_diagnostic_grade.interpretation: All-data fit groups include this valid-panel data. The result is a bounded exposed diagnostic only; it is not held-out evidence or a public-score forecast.

review_findings: Member checkpoint, provenance, export and tensor hashes resolve through the sealed source bindings and build receipt; fixed equal coefficients match the package member list.

Selective dtype conversion is limited to the five declared tensors per member; remaining arrays preserve float32 identity in the builder receipt. ZIP is below the 20,000,000-byte limit and CRC was sealed by the actor.

The package uses the existing precision-aware native ensemble path. Exact-ZIP Python 3.11 and Python 3.13 panels both report Q8VNNI, finite outputs and deterministic reset replay; the P311 output hash matches the P313 panel.
The measured FP16 transport grade is effectively tied to the FP32 transport control on the exposed panel; it supports the size tradeoff but does not establish generalization.
limitations: This review independently reran the bounded P311 callback panel but did not rerun the actor's P313 panel, builder, or grade.
Full-data training used train and valid groups; the diagnostic panel reuses exposed valid groups.
No leaderboard score or expected-public score is asserted.
